observed_facts: Emmett & Corps Ltd, company 09598868, with personal guarantees pays £28,500 under a ten-year lease from 5 February 2024.
The published lease term runs to 4 February 2034.
The first and second floor residential flat is sold off for 999 years from 13 December 2010 at peppercorn rent.
The property is Sold Prior and no sale price is published.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No sale price was inferred. The residential long lease and peppercorn were not counted as occupational income, and the personal guarantees were recorded without assigning an unsupported covenant value.

observed_facts: Boots UK Limited, company 00928555, is active and pays £40,000.
The renewed five-year lease began on 16 April 2026.
The tenant may determine on 16 April 2029 before the nominal April 2031 expiry.
The property remains Available without a published guide.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £40,000 rent was not treated as secure beyond the April 2029 option, and no future reviewed rent or guide value was inferred.

candidate_observations.address: Unit 11 Albion Industrial Estate, Endemere Road, Coventry, CV6 5PY
observed_facts: Steer Automotive Group Limited, company 08239702, is active and pays £36,000.
The ten-year lease runs from 5 February 2019 to 4 February 2029 with no breaks.
The property comprises approximately 2,373 square feet on a 0.18-acre site with about twelve parking spaces.
The property sold for £399,000.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No lease extension or post-February-2029 income was inferred, and general company charges were not treated as evidence of default at this property.

candidate_observations.address: 85-95 Great Portland Street, 5 All Souls Place and 30-34 Langham Street, London, W1W 7NY
observed_facts: The freehold ground-rent investment sold for £805,000 and produces a published total of £16,203.
The total includes £12,000 from a telecom mast licence ending 12 December 2026 plus low ground rents from commercial and residential interests.
Two £2,000 rents are scheduled to rise to £3,000 in 2028 and £4,000 in 2053.
The asset has commercial and selected residential reversions in 2077 and 2086, while many residential underleases have been extended beyond those dates.
candidate_observations.guardrail: Future stepped rents were not presented as current income. No reversion value was calculated, the telecom underlease rent was not double-counted, and a holding-over substation shilling was not converted into modern income.

candidate_observations.address: Unit 29 Skelton Industrial Estate, Skelton, Cleveland, TS12 2LQ
observed_facts: Endeavour Leisure (UK) Ltd, company 08010436, is in administration and pays £28,313 with a personal guarantor.
The nominal lease term runs to 25 July 2033.
A rent review and tenant option to determine both fall on 25 July 2028, with at least twelve months written notice required for the break.
The property sold for £280,000; Companies House records all three registered charges as satisfied, including one identifying the Skelton unit.
candidate_observations.guardrail: Administration was recorded as covenant risk, not proof of rent default or lease termination. The £28,313 was not projected beyond the 2028 option and the satisfied charge was not treated as an outstanding liability.

It provides approximately 24,516 square feet over ground to fifth floors.

Subdivision, multi-let occupation, owner occupation or alternative strategies remain subject to necessary consents where applicable.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No occupational income, subdivision yield, alternative-use permission or development value was inferred from the vacant building.

observed_facts: The £63,100 total comprises £47,500 from Flight Centre (UK) Limited, company 02937210, and £15,600 from a residential AST.
The ten-year retail lease began on 29 September 2019 and runs to September 2029; the 2024 tenant break was not exercised.
The two-bedroom maisonette AST expired on 1 September 2024 and is holding over at £1,300 per month.
The property is Sold Prior and no sale price is published.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The holding-over AST was not represented as long-dated corporate income, the unexercised break was not treated as a lease extension, and no sale price was inferred.

candidate_observations.address: Former Faversham Garden Centre, London Road, Faversham, Kent, ME9 9JY
observed_facts: The approximately 22.50-acre former garden-centre site is vacant.
A positive pre-application response was received in May 2022 for a twelve-unit industrial scheme totalling 342,755 square feet.
The listing states that alternative uses or redevelopment remain subject to all necessary consents.
The property is Sold Post and no sale price is published.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The pre-application response was not represented as planning permission. No sale price, industrial development value, unit value or alternative-use approval was inferred.
